replay: Last-Event-ID or after; persistent increasing id; consumers deduplicate by id
clock: occurredAt and receivedAt are Unix milliseconds at receipt on the exhibition PC
crossOrigin: Pass --event-origin https://exact-consumer-origin to the launcher. No destination is enabled by default.
inbox: Five fixed preset messages plus current-loop messages. messages.reset clears transient inbox entries at each new loop; event replay remains durable.
